measurement: export button with an explicit accessibility click listener: native probe
result: NEGATIVE for the dialog, with a gap in what was captured. The probe recorded the pre-invoke state (support-export-status absent, support-export-trace absent), the export button being present and its accessibility invoke returning without an exception, and then that no save dialog appeared among the top-level windows. It did NOT re-read the status or trace elements after the invoke, so "they never appeared" is not directly evidenced by this artifact - only that they were absent before it.
what_this_does_not_show: Two things: the post-invoke element state was not captured, and the export path has no in-process handler-entry trace, so this probe cannot say whether export_support ran and stopped later, or never ran at all.
next_step: Instrument the export path the same way the preview path was instrumented (closed tokens on stderr behind an environment variable) and repeat the probe. Only then can the dispatch question be answered for this button.
